chapter: Lester Nelson and New Orleans players
title: Eddie Miller and Jack O'Toole at Werlein's
summary: Knew Eddie Miller at 15 at Werlein's and drummer Jack O'Toole, who became an alcoholic.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Was he older or younger than Eddie?
Oh, my Lord, yeah. He was much older.
I knew Eddie Miller. When I first came to New Orleans, Eddie Miller was 15 years old. I was 19.

Eddie Miller was in the band instrument department in the Whirlines, in the band instrument repair department. I remember him just as plain as day. Jack O'Toole played drums. He played in different bands. He was in the band instrument department. Jack O'Toole, I just learned, died not too long ago. He was in Shreveport. Hmm. Jack was about two years older than I.

Yeah, but way back in those days. Jack became an alcoholic. And he went into business for himself. And then he lost the business. And from just, he would go on a drunk and stay drunk three or four weeks at a time. And wind up in the hospital and they'll kill him.
See, who did he play with? I just can't remember.
Oh, that was bands back in Charlie Cordella and all of those fellas. Oh, yeah, I see. Yeah. And I can't tell you to save my life. Joe Caprera. Mm-hmm. Joe Caprera and those different fellas.
Leo Addy. August Schellang. Mm-hmm. Red Bullman, possibly. Yeah.
